name: Screensaver
description: Screensaver before the idle lock: Omarchy's ttfx effects in a fullscreen terminal per monitor (ttfx), or a drifting clock and branding overlay on every screen (native); any input ends it

style.description: ttfx (Omarchy's screensaver: ttfx over the branding text in a fullscreen terminal per monitor; needs the AUR package ttfx) or native (clock and branding on the theme background)

clockFormat.description: Qt time format of the native clock

debugIpc.description: Debug: expose the haseen.screensaver IPC target (dismiss, state, startIdle) for smoke tests
